items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: We'd gotten into the composer's music of this period, which is Chick Corea Correa and many others.

ctx.x: Yeah, but I think this has been a productive period from '69 on, as far as producing, once again, -- what I hope would be another approach and another way. We'd
gotten into the composer's music of this period, which is Chick Corea Correa and many others.
